summary: Slack collection reads, archive sync, offline reports and MCP must share verified workspace/conversation/message identity, canonical current state and scope-owned pagination.
reason: Slack envelopes and overlapping endpoints cannot be safely cached through generic timestamp-only resource extraction; losing request identity or trusting suffix cursors causes collisions, omissions and false completeness. Preserve verified backup/quarantine recovery and atomic page/checkpoint commits on regeneration.
validated_outcome: Fixtures verify real Slack envelopes, observer mismatch isolation, WAL-safe migration, edits/tombstones, frozen archive resume, retained-root reply discovery and CLI/typed/command MCP collection parity.
